summary: Completed testing of 'Compartilhar PDF' feature for empréstimos. Backend endpoint and frontend button both working correctly. Fixed data mapping issue in PDF generation.

minor.issue: FIXED - PDF was showing R$ 0.00 and 0% due to field name mismatch (valor_emprestimo vs valor_principal, taxa_juros vs taxa_juros_mensal)

ui_bugs.issue: Table displays 'undefined%/undefinedm' in TAXA/PRAZO column and 'R$ 0,00' for values - data mapping issue between API response and display
ui_bugs.note: Not related to PDF feature - existing issue

passed_tests: PDF has content-disposition header with filename
PDF content is valid (starts with %PDF header)
Frontend 'Compartilhar PDF' button visible in action menu
PDF download triggers correctly from frontend
PDF contains: client data, loan info, parcelas table, totals
action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix emprestimos table display showing 'undefined%/undefinedm' - this is a separate issue from the PDF feature
critical_code_review_comments: PDF endpoint now handles both field naming conventions (valor_principal/valor_emprestimo, taxa_juros_mensal/taxa_juros, etc.)
seed_data_creation: Used existing 44 emprestimos and 20 clientes from database
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF sharing feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoint at /api/emprestimos/{id}/compartilhar-pdf generates valid PDF with client data, loan info, parcelas table and totals. Frontend button in action menu triggers download correctly. Note: emprestimos table has a separate display issue showing undefined values.

Informações do Empréstimo (Data, Valor Principal, Taxa, Tipo, Total Parcelas, Status)
